title: Oven Roasted Indian Myeongnan Roe Vindaloo
description: A briny and snappy Indian dish featuring myeongnan-roe, made FODMAP-friendly and served as a solo dinner vindaloo.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together yakimono-grill sauce, ghee, ginger, curry powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the myeongnan-roe to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce mixture.
Spread the myeongnan-roe mixture on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the myeongnan-roe in the preheated oven for 12 minutes.
While the myeongnan-roe is roasting, heat a small skillet over medium heat and saute the green onion until softened.
After the myeongnan-roe has roasted for 12 minutes, remove it from the oven and stir in the sauteed green onion and lemon juice.
Return the myeongnan-roe mixture to the oven and roast for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the myeongnan-roe from the oven and serve hot.
